issues.description: The Person.firstName attribute has conflicting types between the template and the solution. In the template Person.java the field is declared as String (e.g., private String firstName;), and all tests and the problem description treat firstName as a String (setFirstName("Max")). However, in the solution repository Person.java the firstName field is declared as an int (private int firstName;), while its getter/setter and other code still expect a String. This is a structural type mismatch that will cause compilation errors in the solution, and will confuse students because the solution does not match the template/tests' expected data type for firstName.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Person.firstName attribute type consistent with the template and tests by changing the solution's declaration from int to String (private String firstName;). Ensure the getter and setter signatures and their return/parameter types match String, and update equals/hashCode if necessary. This aligns the solution with the template/tests and resolves the compilation mismatch.
